Corollary
[classification of complete constant curvature spaces]

Source: petersen:page-0218 ↗ thm:pet-ch5-monodromy-theorem ↗ prop:pet-ch5-covering-completeness 1. ch5:5.6.14If $(M,g)$ is connected, geodesically complete, with constant curvature $k$, its universal cover is isometric to $S^n_k$.
Proof

↗ cor:pet-ch5-classification-constant-curvature \sketch The universal cover remains complete by item 4. The map supplied by subsection 6.2 is both a local isometry and a diffeomorphism onto $S_k^n$, hence a global isometry.

□
